import pandas as pd, numpy as np, cv2
img=cv2.imread('demo_rgb.png'); H,W=img.shape[:2]
inp=pd.read_csv('demo_metadata.csv',index_col=0); d=pd.read_csv('out/demo_metadata.csv',index_col=0)
assert len(d)==len(inp) and (d.drop(columns=['xmin','xmax','ymin','ymax','coords_x','coords_y']).equals(inp.drop(columns=['xmin','xmax','ymin','ymax','coords_x','coords_y'])))
for S in (1,8):
  cnt=np.zeros((H*S,W*S),int); bad=0
  for _,r in d.iterrows():
    xs=np.array(list(map(int,r.coords_x.split(','))));ys=np.array(list(map(int,r.coords_y.split(','))))
    m=np.zeros_like(cnt,np.uint8); cv2.fillPoly(m,[(np.stack([xs,ys],1)*S+S//2).astype(np.int32)],1)
    n,_=cv2.connectedComponents(m); bad+= n!=2
    cnt+=m
    assert len(set(zip(xs,ys)))>4
    assert r.xmin==xs.min() and r.ymax==ys.max()
  print('scale',S,'overlap px',(cnt>1).sum(),'noncontig',bad)
vis=img.copy()
for _,r in inp.iterrows():
  p=np.stack([list(map(int,r.coords_x.split(','))),list(map(int,r.coords_y.split(',')))],1); cv2.polylines(vis,[p],True,(255,0,0),1)
for _,r in d.iterrows():
  p=np.stack([list(map(int,r.coords_x.split(','))),list(map(int,r.coords_y.split(',')))],1); cv2.polylines(vis,[p],True,(0,255,0),1)
cv2.imwrite('vis.png',cv2.resize(np.hstack([img,vis]),None,fx=2,fy=2,interpolation=cv2.INTER_NEAREST))
EOF
